clues.text: Leah's firstborn son, named because she said the LORD had seen her affliction.
During the wheat harvest, this son of Jacob found mandrakes in the field and brought them to his mother.
When Joseph's brothers plotted to kill him, this brother urged them to throw him into a pit, hoping to rescue him.
In Egypt's famine, this son told Jacob he could kill his two sons if Benjamin did not come back.
While Israel lived beyond the Tower of Eder, this son slept with his father's concubine Bilhah.
Blessing his sons before he died, Jacob called this one uncontrolled as the waters, saying he would no longer excel.
In Deborah's song, this tribe's clans sat among the sheepfolds in great indecision instead of joining the battle.
